title: Correct mast height
description: Essential: The final answer for h₂ must be 3 m.

title: Correct travel time
description: Essential: The final answer for t must be (20/9) × 10⁻⁸ s.

title: Geometry setup
description: Important: The solution must correctly split the total horizontal distance (7 m) into two segments using the given angles (37° and 53°).

title: Snell's Law application
description: Important: The solution must apply Snell's law (n = sin θ_air / sin θ_water) to find the refractive index of water.

title: Speed in medium
description: Important: The solution must correctly calculate the speed of light in water using v = c / n.

title: Path length calculation
description: Important: The solution must calculate the distance traveled in water using the geometry (h₁ / cos 37°).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The final answers should include correct units (m and s).

title: Angle confusion
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the incident/refracted angles are swapped in Snell's law (e.g., using sin 37°/sin 53°).

title: Trigonometric error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if tan 37° or tan 53° is misused (e.g., using the wrong opposite/adjacent sides).
